posts.author: katsurachan
posts.body:
Hi! My name is Holly Katsura // 桂 ホリー
A little bit about me...I love to draw and illustrate, pixel art is one of my favorite hobbies. I have been
making + editing sprites for RPG Maker Toolkit since 2003, mostly for 素材 // material.
I am fluent in both Japanese and English languages. I live both in Japan and outside of Japan depending on season.
My husband is Japanese, he works in software development.
I look forward to sharing tiles, sprites and other resources with you! ~
Thank you for reading! // ありがとう!
​
